Method of Attack: Exploiting an unquoted path zero-day vulnerability in Apple Software Update for Windows to launch ransomware payload
Abusing the unquoted path vulnerability to execute ransomware instead of the legitimate Apple Software Update binary
Using a malicious binary named 'Program' without extension placed in writable folders to evade detection
Impacted Systems: Windows devices running Apple Software Update service bundled with iTunes and iCloud for Windows
Attack Vector: Unquoted path vulnerability in Apple Software Update service binary execution path
Write privileges to folders such as C drive or Program Files to place malicious binary
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious binary named 'Program' without extension placed in writable folders
Use of signed Apple Software Update binary to launch ransomware payload
